verdict.rationale: Amazon Bedrock is AWS's first-party platform offering access to hundreds of foundation models from leading AI companies, and AWS's own tutorial uses the Claude 3 Sonnet frontier model through Bedrock. AWS publishes machine-readable models for all public AWS API services, which supports the documented-API part only generically. missing for 10: explicit evidence of open-weight models on Bedrock, a Bedrock-specific inference API reference (e.g. invoke/converse endpoints), independent or hands-on corroboration of managed inference.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, models are a platform service — first-party managed inference over frontier and open models with a documented API

citations.quote: Amazon Bedrock gives you access to hundreds of FMs from leading AI companies along with evaluation tools to pick the best model based on your unique performance and cost needs.
